North is a tall, narrow column of overlapping dorsal plates with a ridge down the spine, and a tapered, ringed tail tip at the bottom. North is clearly the tallest view and east the shortest.
observed.south.png: A head-on front view. A heavy bone-coloured head shield with pitted, cratered texture, two small amber eyes under the brow, and a gaping mouth with many sharp teeth and two large downward tusks or mandibles. Beneath it is a heavy body on rows of ivory conical claw-feet. A segmented tail curls up behind on the left. The skin is purple-grey with bone-white plates. observed.east.png: A side profile of a long, thick, segmented worm. Overlapping purple-grey, pitted carapace plates run along the back, and paired ivory spike-legs run along the underside. observed.north.png: A view of the back: a long column of overlapping dorsal plates with a central ridge, narrowing from a wider front end at the top to a coiled, conical tail tip at the bottom, nearest the camera. request.prompt: A single RimWorld creature sprite: the vurra, a massive alien worm of uncertain origin, painted fresh in the painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, on a transparent background. The sprite has a clean charcoal-dark outline, and every edge pixel blends from that outline or from the adjacent armor and ivory spike colour smoothly into transparency, so the silhouette is crisp and cleanly cut. The body is thick and long, many times the girth of a human arm and long enough to loom over a lone traveler, nowhere near earthworm scale. The head is a predator's head that can threaten someone, with a strong armored brow, a broad jaw and a menacing, watchful look. The skin is plainly alien: overlapping hard plates in slate-violet and bone-grey with a mottled, pitted, faintly glossy texture and darker ridges between the plates. The palette is cool and neutral throughout: slate-violet, bone-grey, ivory and charcoal. Along the underside runs a row of small, pale ivory spiked legs, short and sharp like bone thorns, evenly spaced, all the same size and shape, each with a clean charcoal outline and crisp edges against the transparent background, including the legs on the left side of the body in the rear view and the front view. The creature is neither fast nor frenzied: it is heavy, deliberate and menacing, body resting low with the head slightly raised. Reference: none; build the body from this description.

observed.facings.png: Three facings at one shared scale on a checkerboard. Each is a tall, closed, cone-shaped canopy of drab grey-brown membrane. Jointed rib-bones run from a pointed central finial at the top down to clawed tips at a scalloped hem. Two scaly, bird-like clawed feet stick out underneath. South has a narrow vertical slit with a red interior low on the centre front. East leans slightly, with the feet in profile, and the slit shows at the right edge. North has no slit, and the feet show their heels. All three are about the same height.
observed.south.png: A symmetric furled cone. About nine jointed ribs radiate from a small spiked finial and end in hooked claw-tips along a scalloped lower edge. The membrane is finely textured grey-tan. A lens-shaped slit with a dark red inside sits just above the hem, on the centre rib line. Two scaly legs with curved talons point toward the viewer. There is no eye, ear, snout or fur. Clean black/alpha background with no ground or shadow.
observed.east.png: The same furled cone seen from the side, with a slight forward lean. The ribs converge on the finial. The red slit is visible at the right (front) edge near the hem. Both feet are in profile, talons pointing right, and the hem flares slightly at the back-left. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: The same cone from behind, symmetric, with the same ribs, finial and scalloped hem. There is no slit, eye or face. The two feet show the backs of the heels and toes splayed sideways. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the candidate is about the human's height and slightly wider at the base. At 32 px per cell it reads as a dark grey-brown cone, distinct from the ground and about the human's size.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the front: the lens-shaped red slit sits centred on the front, and the talons point toward the camera. The front cue is subtle because the creature has no face by design.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows the plain back of the canopy with no slit, eyes or face, and the heels of the feet face the camera.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three are elevation views at the game angle: the finial is at the top and the feet are at the bottom. None shows a radial top-down umbrella disc.

SAME_SIZE.seen: Measured height spread is 4%. The panel agrees.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: The same rib count, membrane, finial and feet appear on every facing. The slit is centred on south, at the front edge on east and absent on north, so it turns with the body. The feet turn correctly too.

SIGNATURE.seen: The 'folded umbrella nobody wants' silhouette is the whole read: a closed canopy on a central shaft with a spike finial.

ALIEN.seen: No bat head, ears or fur. It reads as a furled umbrella on bird feet, not as an Earth animal.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1 present: the whole body is a closed, furled canopy with no separate furry torso. 2 present: radial ribs converge on a central finial or shaft like umbrella spokes, not two paired wing hands. 3 present: it stands hunched upright on clawed feet suited to gripping a perch, not hanging. 4 present: no ears, snout or fur; drab and object-like.

STYLE.seen: Painterly and finely textured, with realistic bone joints and membrane. Not cel-shaded or cute, and not a photo or 3D render.

OURS.seen: A unique invented design, not a vanilla or other-mod creature.

ALPHA.seen: Real alpha on all facings. No ground patch, perch or shadow under the feet.
